SpeechSynthesis

Baseline Widely available
This feature is well established and works across many devices and browser versions.

The SpeechSynthesis interface of the Web Speech API is the controller interface for the speech service. It can be used to retrieve information about the synthesis voices available on the device, start and pause speech, and run other commands.

Instance properties

SpeechSynthesis.paused Read only

A boolean value that returns true if the speech queue is in a paused state.

SpeechSynthesis.pending

A boolean value that returns true if the utterance queue contains as-yet-unspoken utterances.

Examples

First, we grab a reference to the speech synthesis controller and populate a menu with the available voices.

js
const synth = window.speechSynthesis;
const voices = synth.getVoices();

Inside the submit handler, we create a new utterance from the text input and pass it to the speak method.
